getCart.description: Returns checkout data for the current cart. The cart ID is retrieved from the internal state.
getCart.returns: checkout cart data including billing address, shipping addresses, payment methods, and cart status

authenticated.description: A boolean indicating whether the user has been authenticated or not.

input.description: An object of type EstimateShippingInput, which contains a criteria object including the following fields: country_code, region_name, region_id, and zip.

cart.description: The cart data to initialize the checkout process, or null to retrieve the cart from internal state.

email.description: A string representing the email address to check for availability.

input.description: The billing address to set on the cart, including street, city, region, country, and postal code.

email.description: The guest customer's email address for order confirmation and communication.

input.description: The payment method code and additional payment data required by the selected payment processor.
The shipping address to set on the cart, including street, city, region, country, and postal code.

shippingMethods.description: The shipping methods to apply to the cart, each containing a carrier code and method code.

cart.description: The cart data to synchronize with the checkout state, or null to retrieve the cart from internal state.
